key.blockwheel.open: Hold to open block family wheel
ui.blockwheel.title: Reshape
message.blockwheel.hold_block: Hold a building block to open its family wheel.
message.blockwheel.no_family: This block has no known shape counterparts.
message.blockwheel.custom_data: Reshaping requires an ordinary block stack without custom item data.
message.blockwheel.changed: Your held stack changed. Open the wheel again.
message.blockwheel.need_batch: You need %s input items for one complete batch.
message.blockwheel.server_missing: This server also needs Blockwheel installed.
ui.blockwheel.builder_tooltip: Turn on the optional inventory, restock and retrieval features you have enabled. The block wheel works even when Builder Mode is off.
ui.blockwheel.builder.pickup.tooltip: Use picked-up material to refill matching hotbar shapes, then store the rest as compact base material. For example, extra stone stairs can be stored as stone.
ui.blockwheel.builder.normalize.tooltip: Store building materials in their base forms as you move them through main inventory. With experimental wood, small amounts become planks and suitable batches become logs.
ui.blockwheel.builder.restock.tooltip: Refill the item you use in either hand. Other hotbar slots are left alone. The Supply page lets you include shulkers and your ender chest.
ui.blockwheel.builder.pick_block.tooltip: Middle-click a block to find it or make its shape from matching material. The Supply page lets pick block also look inside shulkers and your ender chest.
ui.blockwheel.builder.tooltips.tooltip: Show how much compatible building material you have when hovering over an item. Stairs, slabs and other shapes count toward the same family total.
ui.blockwheel.builder.shulker_supply.too: Let restock and pick block take items from carried shulkers. Named shulkers keep one item in each occupied slot so their layout stays ready for refilling.
ui.blockwheel.builder.ender_access.toolt: Let enabled supply features use your ender chest without opening it. Restock uses its shulkers; pick block can also find loose items. The server must allow remote access.
ui.blockwheel.builder.shulker_pick_block: Let enhanced pick block search your shulkers. With ender chest access on, it can search there too. Turn on Shulker Supply to use these sources.
ui.blockwheel.builder.shulker_tooltips.t: Add accessible shulker contents to material tooltips. Items kept as named-shulker templates are listed separately from usable supplies.
ui.blockwheel.builder_icon_tooltip:
Builder Mode: %s
Compact materials and refill building supplies.

Left-click to %s
Right-click for Blockwheel settings
ui.blockwheel.deposit_hold_hint: Release to fill from main inventory. Hold for 0.6 seconds to include the hotbar and offhand.
ui.blockwheel.deposit_tooltip:
Fill named ender shulkers
Move matching items into existing named-shulker stacks. Empty slots and unnamed shulkers are ignored.
ui.blockwheel.deposit_server_disabled: Remote ender chest access is disabled by the server. Open your ender chest to fill its named shulkers.
ui.blockwheel.deposit_unavailable: Open your ender chest, or enable Ender chest access. Finish moving any cursor-held item first.
ui.blockwheel.deposit_tooltip_builder:
Fill named ender shulkers
Fill existing named-shulker stacks from compatible items. Compatible family shapes convert while Builder Mode is enabled. Empty slots and unnamed shulkers are ignored.
ui.blockwheel.world_preferences: Preferences are saved for this world.
ui.blockwheel.world_required: Join a world to change gameplay options.
ui.blockwheel.restock_below.tooltip: Start refilling after use when your hand falls below this count. At the default of 6, a refill starts with 5 items left. Set 1 to refill only when empty.
ui.blockwheel.restock_amount.tooltip: Add up to this many items each time, stopping when the stack is full or supplies run out. The default adds 32 items.
ui.blockwheel.restock_non_blocks.tooltip: Allow hand restock to take food, fireworks, pearls and other non-placeable items from shulkers. Turn this off to keep shulker restocking focused on building blocks.
ui.blockwheel.pick.instance_preferences: Fallback rules are saved for this Minecraft instance.
ui.blockwheel.pick.search_blocks: Search blocks by name or ID
ui.blockwheel.pick.order_hint: Exact match first. Fallbacks run top to bottom.
ui.blockwheel.pick.load_failed: Could not load pick rules. See the log.
ui.blockwheel.pick.save_failed: Could not save pick rules. See the log.
ui.blockwheel.pick.limit: Too many rules or fallback data.
ui.blockwheel.builder.wood_trapdoors.too: Add wooden trapdoors to the bottom-right of wooden block wheels. One trapdoor costs three planks. Also lets enabled Builder features use that same relationship.
ui.blockwheel.interface.hide_tooltips.to: Hide hover help on the inventory Builder switch and named-shulker fill button. Settings help and item tooltips stay visible.
ui.blockwheel.interface.hide_messages.to: Hide the Builder Mode ON/OFF message above the hotbar. Toggle sounds still play.
ui.blockwheel.interface.load_failed: Could not load interface preferences; see the log.
ui.blockwheel.interface.save_failed: Could not save interface preferences; see the log.
Add unstripped logs and wood to wooden block wheels. One log or wood block equals four planks. Builder Mode uses planks for small amounts and logs for suitable batches, without adding clutter. Stripped blocks stay separate.
ui.blockwheel.interface.radial_only.tool: Turn off Builder Mode and hide the optional inventory buttons. Keep your wheel options and other preferences so you can turn features back on later.
ui.blockwheel.deposit_wood_tooltip_build:
Fill named shulkers
Top up existing stacks in carried and accessible ender shulkers. Compatible wood shapes fill log stacks first. Leftover material stays in your inventory.
ui.blockwheel.deposit_wood_tooltip:
Fill named shulkers
Top up existing matching stacks in carried and accessible ender shulkers. Turn on Builder Mode to also use compatible shapes.
ui.blockwheel.settings.title: Blockwheel Settings
ui.blockwheel.settings.wheel.description: Hold R, point to a shape, then release to convert.
ui.blockwheel.settings.builder.descripti: Keep building materials compact and organized.
ui.blockwheel.settings.restock.descripti: Refill the item you are using as it runs low.
ui.blockwheel.settings.supply.descriptio: Choose where restock and pick block can find items.
ui.blockwheel.settings.pick.description: Find the block you pick, or a useful substitute.
ui.blockwheel.settings.interface.descrip: Choose which buttons and messages you see.
ui.blockwheel.settings.wheel_scope: Works with Builder Mode off. Saved for this world.
ui.blockwheel.settings.pick_scope: %s | Fallback rules saved for this instance
ui.blockwheel.pick.enabled.tooltip: If the requested block cannot be found or made, select a substitute from its fallback list. Edit the rules to choose which alternatives you prefer.
ui.blockwheel.pick.log_defaults.tooltip: Use same-species log and wood substitutes when the requested form is missing. For example, picking stripped wood can select an available unstripped log.
ui.blockwheel.pick.anvil_defaults.toolti: Use the closest available anvil damage state. If both are equally close, prefer the more damaged anvil. The item itself is not repaired or changed.
ui.blockwheel.pick.copper_defaults.toolt: Use a matching copper shape with the closest wax or oxidation state when the exact finish is missing. The selected item keeps its actual finish.
ui.blockwheel.pick.edit_rules.tooltip: Choose target blocks and ordered alternatives with searchable block pictures. Custom rules replace the built-in choices for that target.
ui.blockwheel.interface.show_builder.too: Show the Builder Mode switch in your inventory. When hidden, you can still use these settings or its keybind to change the mode.
ui.blockwheel.interface.show_refill.tool: Show buttons for filling existing stacks in named shulkers. Hiding them leaves supply features and the fill keybind available.
